rules.description: loans data must contain all required columns: loan_id, principal_amount, loan_status.
payments data must contain all required columns: payment_id, loan_id, amount_paid, payment_status.

Every payment_status value in raw payments must be within business_rules.valid_payment_statuses. An unrecognized value (e.g. a new upstream status) fails this check even if downstream totals still reconcile.
Every loan_status value in raw loans must be within business_rules.valid_loan_statuses.
Every payment.loan_id must reference a loan_id present in raw loans.
portfolio_summary.loan_count must match the number of raw loan records.
portfolio_summary.payment_count must match the number of raw payment records.
portfolio_summary.successful_payment_count must match the count of raw payments whose payment_status is in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses, computed independently from raw data.
portfolio_summary.active_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == ACTIVE.
portfolio_summary.closed_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == CLOSED.
portfolio_summary.defaulted_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == DEFAULTED.
portfolio_summary.total_original_principal must match the sum of principal_amount across raw loans, computed independently from raw data.

portfolio_summary.total_successful_payments must match the sum of amount_paid across raw payments whose payment_status is in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses, computed independently from raw data.

portfolio_summary.total_outstanding_balance must match (independently computed total_original_principal - total_successful_payments), computed directly from raw data rather than trusting the ETL's own arithmetic.

Informational: loans with zero payment records at all (e.g. newly originated loans whose first payment is not yet due). Not itself a failure -- see loan_count/active_loan_count/total_original_principal/total_outstanding_balance reconciliation for whether the ETL correctly included them anyway.
